verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly claims compatibility with Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code, and any framework, and docs confirm support for major frameworks and languages (docs-17, docs-6, docs-7). However, developers still need Cloudflare-specific tooling (Wrangler CLI) to deploy, and community feedback highlights real lock-in concerns—storage primitives like KV/D1 tie code to Cloudflare, no full Node.js runtime blocks straightforward migration of existing Node apps, and some found the DX less desirable than self-hosted alternatives.
